background: Spoelstra joined the Heat as video coordinator in 1995, rose through the scouting and assistant ranks under Pat Riley, and became head coach in April 2008; he has coached only Miami. Six Finals trips (2011-14, 2020, 2023), two titles (2012, 2013), roughly 830 regular-season wins through 2025-26, and Finals runs as a No. 5 seed (2020) and No. 8 seed (2023). Signed a record-setting eight-year extension in January 2024 and was named USA Basketball men's head coach for the 2028 Olympic cycle (reported 2025). League executives repeatedly vote him the NBA's best coach; CBS Sports ranked him the third-best coach of the 21st century. 2024-25 (37-45, swept in R1) and 2025-26 (43-39, play-in loss to Charlotte) were a down cycle, though he rebuilt the offense around pace in 2025-26 (2nd in NBA in points per game). The 2026 offseason brought Giannis Antetokounmpo and the loss of All-Star Norman Powell to Chicago; Miami opened 2026-27 0-4 for the first time since 2007-08.

Unmatched development of undrafted and young players (Robinson, Vincent, Strus, Martin, Adebayo, Herro)
